newsitem.title: USA: Infosafe names Medici CEO, president.
newsitem.headline: Infosafe names Medici CEO, president.

text.p: Infosafe Systems Inc said Thursday it named Arthur Medici as president and chief executive officer.
Medici succeeds Thomas Lipscomb, who was named chairman. The chairman position had been vacant for over a year, Infosafe said.

Medici most recently served as president of the North American division of Derwent Information Ltd, which produces international patent abstracts and information formatted for print, CD-ROM and digital online delivery.
Infosafe develops proprietary distribution systems that protect and meter the use of digital information.
